name: [v1.8.0] The Feinberg Update!
body: ### Ever since Feinberg came back to speedrunning 1.16.1 All Advancements I've been trying to get him to test Advancely. Not only, because it would be great exposure, but because I genuinely believe Advancely is the next step of Minecraft trackers, with Hermes, a transparent overlay, (by default) no infinitely scrolling Endermites, ... ### Knowing Feinberg is lazy I was super motivated to make Advancely a lot more similar to AATool (especially the overlay) and more accessible with a proper settings search bar, a new `1.16.1 AATool` settings preset, a sophisticated presets import window. > [!IMPORTANT] > **Getting the new AATool settings preset when using the auto-updater:** v1.7.2's updater doesn't copy settings presets yet, so updating from v1.7.2 won't bring in the new `1.16.1 AATool` preset. To get it, start Advancely with the `--update` flag **after** this update and run the update a second time. Otherwise it arrives with the next release. The Linux packages (.deb/.rpm/AUR/NixOS) include it right away. > Go watch the [devlog](https://youtu.be/xyF4cqtsZvs) for a full breakdown! ## Settings & Presets - **Settings search:** a search bar in the settings window (Ctrl+F, Cmd+F on macOS) searches setting names, their tooltips and hotkeys, so typing e.g. "F11" shows the matching hotkey and its setting. - **Preset import window:** `Load Preset` now opens a popup listing every setting that differs, so you choose which ones to take over. - **Official AATool preset:** a new `1.16.1 AATool` preset made for the 1.16.1 `all_advancements` `aatool_optimized` template that replicates the classic AATool compact layout as closely as possible. - Auto-updates now ship official presets, and a new [README section](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely#officially-added-settings-presets) lists them. - Creating a preset with a name that already exists can now overwrite the old one. - The launch counter is no longer stored in settings presets. - Added an `Import Template` button directly into the settings window. - Added an `Open Log Folder` button. - On Linux, log files no longer land in the current working directory. ## Overlay - Icon size settings for all three overlay rows (Belt and Page modes). - Option to hide the first row of the overlay, for all modes. Rows 2 and 3 also move up automatically when row 1 has no icons. - New `Show Completed Row 2 Goals` setting. - Compact mode: the panel can show an icon, the panel text can be aligned left or right instead of centered, and there's a new task counter. - New restart overlay button. - The updated timer in the overlay progress text is now off by default. - Fixed fast cycling after the overlay wakes up. ## Tracker - Advancely remembers whether it was fullscreen, and F11 toggles fullscreen. Cmd+Ctrl+F stays reserved for macOS fullscreen. - Any goal's progress text (e.g. `(3/10)`) can be hidden, with a bulk action for sub-stats. Official templates hide it where a target value of 1 makes it redundant. - When a goal's or sub-stat's display name is empty or hidden, its spot goes to the progress text, even if the name was moved in the manual layout. - Click a custom goal's progress text to type its value directly. - Notes are read-only while no world is found, and switching the settings UI font no longer erases the notes text. ## Template Editor & Visual Layout Editor - Text headers can have descriptions. - The `1.16.1` `all_advancements` `aatool_optimized` template has a header added explaining the overlay settings through its description. - Added a new `Selected` checkbox in popups to show only selected items. - The Template Editor bulk selection (`Select All`, `Invert` and `Deselect All`) follows the current search scope. - Run completion can now target a single complex advancement, a complex stat category or recipe criteria. - Optional flags no longer need a leading underscore. A checkbox (on by default) adds or removes it. - Ctrl+S, Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab (Cmd on macOS) work while typing in text fields (except for the notes window). - Fixed copying a counter to properly place the copy right below the original as the other goal types already did. - When you pick a source template under `Import from Template`, `Layout positions` gets ticked automatically if that template has at least one layout file. - Visual Layout Editor: - New `P` hotkey toggles independent positioning for all selected items. - Hidden goals are drawn transparent: `V` (hide from the visual layout) applies right away and `H` (hide from the overlay/automatic layout) applies after saving. - Dragging an item scrolls to the item instead of to the coordinates in the template editor. - Fixes: - A rename in the visual layout editor could move over to another goal. - The selection rectangle now respects items' anchor points. - Range selection in the stages search scope works again. - The stage counter is fixed. ## Templates - All of [Scrambled's](https://www.twitch.tv/scrambledmc) templates updated, plus new 1.12 and 1.16.1 glitched templates, a 1.16.1 half% template and a new 26.4 categorical template. - Added a new `26.4` `all_advancements` `aatool_optimized` template. - [kittymmeow](https://www.twitch.tv/kittymmeow) added two new vertical layouts for the 1.16.1 `aatool_optimized` and `coop` templates. View the official templates/layouts [here](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely#officially-added-templates). - Language files now hold the text header keys of every layout file, which makes credits easier to manage across layouts. - 1.21.11+ AATool templates were cleaned up: the trim main goal is hidden and only the trims remain for consistency. - The 1.16.1 template has a description explaining the best overlay settings. - Line opacity is fixed on the 1.16.1 and 1.17 AATool layouts. - Shorter display names in the `all_blocks` template, updated final stages in some templates, and updated 26.4 biome textures. - 27.2 is already available as a version to select (just always want to be ahead). ----- > Find more info on the [tracker main page](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely)! ----- ## *[Donations](https://streamlabs.com/lnxseus/tip) are always welcome\! Make sure to mention `Advancely` in the donation message.* Enjoy the update\!
